comment: Lines of fixtures/build/facts.json where an extractor does not return the text lamina-build drew, each with the extractor's limitation behind it (todo B5b). crates/lamina-build/tests/external.rs requires every other line to equal the drawn text and every entry here to still match the facts.

exceptions.extracted: नमस्ते दु निया। हिन्दी पाठ का परीक्षण
exceptions.reason: pdf.js treats a glyph whose text contains a nonspacing mark anywhere as a zero-width diacritic (getCharUnicodeCategory's /^(\s)|(\p{Mn})|(\p{Cf})$/u test) and starts a new text item after it: the i-matra glyph standing for “नि” gets a space before it, as on text-shaped.pdf line 5
